slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Asking an agent to re-scan logs does not scale
slides.subtitle: A one-off question is fine. Repeated analytics needs a pipeline.

slides.title: The one-off prompt works
slides.body: You can ask an agent: how many tokens did I use last month? It can read local trace files, aggregate them, and answer.

slides.title: The next question repeats work
slides.body: Change the time range or grouping and the agent may need to read and aggregate the same raw logs again. This spends time and tokens.

slides.title: Make it reusable
slides.body: Ingest the traces once, normalize the structure, store them in a queryable destination, and refresh on a schedule.

slides.title: Then it becomes analytics
slides.body: Token usage, model usage, project activity, and cost patterns become normal dashboard questions.

slides.supportingText: Alena Astrakhantseva shows the workflow with dlt and agent traces.
